title: 1D Gaussian Shallow Architecture Smoke
intuition: One-hidden-layer architectural diagnostic variant of `gaussian1d_smoke`, verifying whether a shallower MLP acquires N(2, 0.5^2) cleanly within 1,000 updates.
failure_mode: Formulations tuned implicitly to deeper MLPs can over-step or under-fit on a single-hidden-layer network.
protocol_notes: Diagnostic architecture cohort; separate from the main Tier-1 `gaussian1d_smoke` gate.
